# Build System & Shell Agent

You are fixing and completing the Mogwser Firefox fork build infrastructure and browser chrome shell. Most files already exist from prior iterations — your job is to fix identified bugs and fill gaps.

## CRITICAL: Read Before Writing
The codebase already has substantial implementations. Run `git log --oneline -10` first, then read every file you plan to modify before making changes.

## Key Fixes

### 1. Fix sessionstore.patch event target
The patch at `patches/sessionstore.patch` dispatches `MogwserSessionRestored` on `document`. It MUST dispatch on `window` to match the listeners in MogwserWorkspaces.mjs and MogwserSplitView.mjs. Change:
```
document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSessionRestored", ...
```
to:
```
window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSessionRestored", ...
```

### 2. Add missing prefs to mogwser.yaml
The file at `prefs/mogwser.yaml` has 27 prefs. Add:
- `mogwser.sidebar.collapsed-width` (int, 48, "Sidebar width in compact mode in pixels")
- `mogwser.splitview.handle-size` (int, 6, "Split-view resize handle thickness in pixels")
- `mogwser.theme.transition-duration` (int, 300, "Theme transition animation duration in milliseconds")
- `mogwser.tabs.show-close-button` (bool, true, "Show close button on tab rows")
- `mogwser.tabs.show-audio-indicator` (bool, true, "Show audio indicator on tabs playing media")

Follow the existing YAML format exactly.

### 3. Verify test manifests
Ensure `tests/browser/browser.toml` lists all 8 browser test files and `tests/unit/xpcshell.toml` lists all 4 unit test files.

## Conventions
- Gluon config: `gluon.json` at project root
- Patches are git-format diffs in `patches/` directory
- Prefs use YAML format with type, value, description fields
- ES modules (.mjs) with chrome privilege, singleton pattern with static init()
- CSS BEM naming: `.mogwser-shell__sidebar`
- Custom events dispatch on `window`, not `document`

# Tab Management Agent

You are fixing and completing the vertical tab bar and workspace system for Mogwser. Most files already exist — fix identified bugs and fill gaps.

## CRITICAL: Read Before Writing
Run `git log --oneline -10` first, then read every file you plan to modify before changes.

## Key Fixes

### 1. Fix workspace rename prompt (MogwserWorkspaces.mjs:452-473)
The current `_promptRename` method has a bug. `Services.prompt.prompt()` returns a boolean (whether OK was clicked), and the new value is stored in the `{value}` parameter object. The code currently does:
```js
const newName = Services.prompt.prompt(window, title, msg, {value: ws.name}, null, {});
if (typeof newName === 'string' && newName.trim()) { ... }
```
Should be:
```js
const nameObj = { value: ws.name };
const ok = Services.prompt.prompt(window, "Rename Workspace", "Enter new name:", nameObj, null, {});
if (ok && nameObj.value && nameObj.value.trim()) {
  MogwserWorkspaces.renameWorkspace(ws.id, nameObj.value.trim());
}
```

### 2. Add workspace keyboard shortcut test
Add a test in `tests/browser/browser_mogwser_workspaces.js` that verifies the keyboard shortcut handler (MogwserWorkspaces._onKeyDown) works by simulating Ctrl+1/Ctrl+2 key events.

## Existing Architecture
- Tab elements: `.mogwser-tab` div with `.mogwser-tab__favicon`, `.mogwser-tab__title`, `.mogwser-tab__audio-btn`, `.mogwser-tab__close-btn`
- Pinned section: `.mogwser-tabs__pinned` at top of sidebar
- Workspace data: `{ id, name, icon, theme, isDefault }`
- Tab-workspace link: `mogwser-workspace-id` attribute on tab element
- Events: `MogwserWorkspaceChanged` on `window`
- Storage: `MogwserWorkspaceStorage` using IOUtils with LZ4 compression

## Conventions
- ES modules (.mjs), static class singletons
- Globals: `window.gMogwserTabBar`, `window.gMogwserWorkspaces`
- Fire CustomEvents on `window` (not document)
- CSS BEM naming
- Tests use `add_task(async function)` pattern with `Assert.ok/equal`

integration.claudeMd:
# Integration Agent

You are merging work from 4 parallel agents into a cohesive Mogwser browser.

## CRITICAL: Read Before Writing
Run `git log --oneline -20` first. Identify all sub-branches. Merge in this order:
1. sub-0 (build system + shell — foundation, patches)
2. sub-1 (tabs + workspaces)
3. sub-2 (advanced UI — split-view, compact, sidepanel)
4. sub-3 (themes + privacy)

## Post-Merge Verification Checklist

### Event Targets
All custom events MUST dispatch on `window`:
- `patches/sessionstore.patch`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSessionRestored", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/workspaces/MogwserWorkspaces.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserWorkspaceChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/themes/MogwserThemeEngine.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserThemeChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/compact/MogwserCompactMode.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserCompactModeChanged", ...))`
- `src/mogwser/splitview/MogwserSplitView.mjs`: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("MogwserSplitViewChanged", ...))`

And all listeners MUST use `window.addEventListener`.

### Storage Integration
- MogwserSplitView._persistGroups must use `MogwserWorkspaceStorage` (imported directly), NOT `window.gMogwserWorkspaces.storage`
- MogwserWorkspaceStorage.save() merges with existing data, preserving `splitGroups` key

### Module Initialization (MogwserShell.mjs)
Verify order: ThemeEngine → TabBar → Workspaces → SplitView → CompactMode → SidePanel → PrivacyPanel

### Preferences
`prefs/mogwser.yaml` must contain 30+ preferences with consistent naming.

### Tests
- `tests/browser/browser.toml`: 8 entries
- `tests/unit/xpcshell.toml`: 4 entries
- All test files should parse without syntax errors
